title: Sell Mineral Rights in Lapoint, UT
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Lapoint, UT | Uintah County
metaDescription: Own a mineral or royalty interest near Lapoint, Utah? We buy fractional Uinta Basin interests directly, with a documented offer before you decide anything.
heroLead: Lapoint sits in the rolling farm country north of Roosevelt, where mineral ownership has stayed with the same families for generations even as the surrounding basin developed around them.
intro: Lapoint is a small unincorporated farming community in Uintah County, north of the more heavily drilled sections near Roosevelt and Fort Duchesne, and mineral interests here tend to be smaller fractional shares tied to family agricultural land rather than large blocks held by a single owner. Development activity in the immediate area has generally been more limited than in the Altamont-Bluebell or Monument Butte cores, but that does not mean an interest here has no value.

We buy fractional mineral and royalty interests near Lapoint directly. If you are holding a deed or an old royalty statement and are not sure what to do with it, send it over and we will tell you plainly what we can offer.

sections.heading: Smaller shares, real value
paragraphs: A lot of the interests we see from the Lapoint area are small fractional shares — sometimes under one percent of a spacing unit — inherited through several generations of a farming family. These interests are often overlooked because the royalty checks are modest and infrequent, but a small share of a producing unit can still carry real value, particularly if the well has a long remaining production life. We price these the same careful way we price a larger interest: against actual production data, not against the size of the check alone.

sections.heading: When there isn't much recent activity nearby
paragraphs: If your tract near Lapoint has not seen recent drilling or leasing interest, that is worth being upfront about — some acreage in this part of the county simply is not in an active development path right now. We will tell you honestly if that is the case for your specific interest, rather than making an offer we cannot stand behind.

faqs.question: My interest is a very small fraction of a unit. Is it worth selling?
faqs.answer: Often yes, even fractions under one percent can carry real value depending on the well's production history. We will give you an honest number based on your actual share.

faqs.question: There hasn't been any drilling activity near my land in years. Does my interest still have value?
faqs.answer: It depends on whether the existing wells are still producing. If there is no current production and no nearby activity, we will tell you honestly if that limits what we can offer.

faqs.question: How do I find out my exact ownership percentage?
faqs.answer: Send us your deed or division order and we will confirm your fractional share against the current well records.
